title: Publish Preview
description: Stops an npm publish shipping the wrong files or failing for good by previewing the npm pack --dry-run --json tarball and flagging .env files and keys, source maps, tests, repo config, large files, entry points missing from the build (with the reason: .gitignore fallback, files list or no build), a version that's already published, private: true and a missing files allowlist, with one-tap fixes that wait for a fresh pack before they count.
